sharedCases.description: Double-quoted scalars with malformed \uXXXX hex escapes are rejected by both parsers.
Double-quoted scalars with truncated \xXX hex escapes are rejected by both parsers.
Double-quoted scalars with \UXXXXXXXX escapes above U+10FFFF are rejected by both parsers.
Quoted scalars followed by non-comment trailing tokens on the same line are rejected.
Root quoted keys without whitespace after the colon are rejected outside flow mappings.
Nested flow sequences and flow mappings support quoted commas, compact colons, quoted keys, empty collections, and trailing commas.

sharedCases.description: Unbalanced nested flow brackets fall back to ordinary Markdown.
Extra closing brackets in flow collections are rejected.

Folded block scalars fold single newlines, keep blank-line and more-indented breaks, ignore indented ---/... lines, and mask embedded fences and images.

sharedCases.description: CRLF frontmatter closed at end-of-file without a trailing newline yields an empty body and end offset at document length.
Classic Mac bare CR delimiter lines are not recognized as YAML frontmatter.
Opening --- followed by \r\r\n is rejected because \r is neither horizontal whitespace nor a valid \r\n pair.
Leading UTF-8 BOM and non-breaking spaces (U+00A0, U+202F) inside YAML values preserve exact boundaries and leave U+2028/U+2029 in the Markdown body intact.

sharedCases.description: Non-breaking space (U+00A0) on the opening --- line is rejected because only ASCII spaces and tabs are allowed on delimiter lines.
Non-breaking space (U+00A0) on the closing ... line is rejected.
Unicode Line Separator (U+2028) after opening --- does not satisfy the LF/CRLF opener requirement.
Plain mapping keys followed immediately by U+00A0 (without ASCII space or tab after :) are rejected by both parsers.

divergences.description: Flow mapping containing a bare scalar without a key-value colon.
divergences.reason: src/frontmatter.ts validates each {...} entry via splitKeyValue(..., true) in parseFlowValue, whereas desktop/frontmatter.py consume_flow on pre-#186 main only checks _flow_state brace balance.

divergences.description: Nested flow collection with improperly interleaved closing brackets ([{a: 1]}).
divergences.reason: src/frontmatter.ts recursively splits nested flow items in parseFlowValue and catches the unclosed '{', whereas desktop/frontmatter.py _flow_state on pre-#186 main tracks separate integer counters without a delimiter stack.

divergences.description: Flow sequence item with two adjacent double-quoted scalars lacking a separating comma.
divergences.reason: src/frontmatter.ts parseFlowValue requires onlyTrailingComment after each comma-split quoted item, whereas desktop/frontmatter.py _flow_state on pre-#186 main toggles quote flags without validating item boundaries.

divergences.description: Double-quoted scalar inside a flow sequence containing a non-hex \uZZZZ escape.
divergences.reason: src/frontmatter.ts parseFlowValue calls parseDoubleQuoted on quoted flow items, whereas desktop/frontmatter.py consume_flow on pre-#186 main relies on _flow_state which skips '\u' without hex validation.

divergences.description: Quoted mapping key followed by U+00A0 non-breaking space before the colon.
divergences.reason: src/frontmatter.ts splitKeyValue uses String.prototype.trimStart() (which strips U+00A0), whereas desktop/frontmatter.py _split_key_value uses str.lstrip(' \t').

divergences.description: Double-quoted scalar value followed by U+00A0 non-breaking space before an inline # comment.
divergences.reason: src/frontmatter.ts onlyTrailingComment uses String.prototype.trimStart() (stripping U+00A0 before '#'), whereas desktop/frontmatter.py _only_trailing_comment uses str.lstrip(' \t').

divergences.description: Double-quoted scalar containing U+2028 Unicode Line Separator followed by unindented text.
divergences.reason: src/frontmatter.ts splits YAML lines only on /\r?\n/ so U+2028 stays inside the single-line quoted scalar, whereas desktop/frontmatter.py yaml_body.splitlines() on pre-#186 main splits on U+2028 into an unindented continuation line (indent 0 < min_indent).

divergences.description: Plain scalar containing U+2029 Paragraph Separator and U+0085 Next Line (NEL).
divergences.reason: src/frontmatter.ts keeps U+2029 and U+0085 inside the single plain scalar line, whereas desktop/frontmatter.py yaml_body.splitlines() on pre-#186 main splits them into root-level lines lacking ':'.

divergences.description: Two root mapping entries separated by U+2028 Line Separator instead of LF/CRLF.
divergences.reason: src/frontmatter.ts keeps both entries on one line and rejects trailing 'author: "Beta"' after the first quoted scalar, whereas desktop/frontmatter.py yaml_body.splitlines() on pre-#186 main splits U+2028 into two valid root key: value lines.

divergences.description: Folded block scalar containing U+2028 Line Separator before unindented text.
divergences.reason: src/frontmatter.ts keeps the line together at indent 2 inside parseBlockScalar, whereas desktop/frontmatter.py yaml_body.splitlines() on pre-#186 main splits at U+2028, exiting consume_block_scalar at indent 0 and failing root mapping validation.
divergences.source:
---
summary: >-
  folded line unindented tail
---
# Body

desktop.body:
---
summary: >-
  folded line unindented tail
---
# Body

divergences.description: YAML scalar containing a bare carriage return (\r) not followed by \n.
divergences.reason: src/frontmatter.ts splits lines on /\r?\n/ (leaving bare \r inside the scalar and preserving \r in maskFrontmatter), whereas desktop/frontmatter.py yaml_body.splitlines() on pre-#186 main splits bare \r into a root line lacking ':'.

divergences.description: Line containing only U+FEFF ZERO WIDTH NO-BREAK SPACE between two YAML mapping entries.
divergences.reason: JavaScript String.prototype.trim() strips U+FEFF so src/frontmatter.ts treats the line as blank, whereas Python str.strip() preserves U+FEFF and desktop/frontmatter.py rejects it as a non-mapping root line.

divergences.description: Double-quoted scalar containing ASCII vertical tab (U+000B) and form feed (U+000C).
divergences.reason: src/frontmatter.ts keeps U+000B and U+000C inside the quoted line, whereas desktop/frontmatter.py yaml_body.splitlines() on pre-#186 main splits on \x0b and \x0c into indent-0 continuation lines.
